correctness.rationale: For t=2n−1, LTE gives the exponents 2a+1 and b. The normalized integer (4^t−1)/3^(a+1) is t/3^a modulo 3, by expanding powers of 4^(3^a). Consequently the digit is 0 mod 3 if b<2a+1 and 2 mod 3 otherwise; for b≤2a+1 its mod-5 digit is 2(t/5^b)3^(−b), and for b>2a+1 it is 5. CRT gives independent valuation densities and four equiprobable 5-adic units in each stratum. Conditional on b≥1 the tail at b≥2a+1 sums to (2/3)/(1−1/75)=25/37; equality uses 4/5 of that tail and strict excess 1/5. The five residue classes for t→t+2 give three deterministic pairs and the two stars sharing exactly (6,9). For arbitrary N, count each included (a,b) stratum via at most eight congruence classes, each with O(1) discrepancy; O((1+log N)^2) strata suffice and the omitted 3- and 5-adic tails have O(1/N) total density. Shifted indices use t≤2N+1. Independent replay `python /workspace/branches/audit_arithmetic_reproduction.py 4` stripped factors of 15 from 10001 actual integers, saw exactly 20 pairs in the first 10000 trials, and found a maximum absolute deviation 47/37 from the exact rational predictions. The frozen verification script was inspected, not executed; the finite sample is only corroboration.
